meta.name: render-3d-product-showcase
meta.description: Assemble a premium 3D product-showcase ad from a config — four beat clips (an orbiting hero rotation, a macro push-in, a physics reveal, a typographic close) normalized to the brand-color canvas, hard-concatenated in order, closed on a deterministic Playwright brand end card, and mixed under one instrumental bed at loudnorm I=-16 (music-only, no VO). Ships the runnable build_endcard.py + build_masters.py; the rotation/macro clips are create-video-fal i2v seeded on a create-image-fal styled hero, the reveal is Veo3 i2v, and the bed is create-music-elevenlabs. Use for the 3d-product-showcase format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从配置一键生成品牌3D产品展示广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作高质量3D产品展示视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a branded 3D product showcase ad video from a config.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-quality 3D product showcase video ads.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装一段 3D 产品展示广告：将四个片段（产品旋转、微距推进、物理特效、品牌结尾）拼接成 720×1280 的视频，并混入背景音乐。
howto.when: 当你提供产品图片、品牌标志和文案，并指定使用 3D 产品展示格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这张产品图做一个 3D 展示广告，品牌标志在这里。
say.note: Claude 会生成四个片段并合成最终视频。

say.text: 给这个口红做一段 15 秒的 3D 产品展示，背景用粉色。
say.note: Claude 会按配置生成旋转、微距、特效和结尾。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can assemble a 3D product showcase ad from a config: it concatenates four clips (hero rotation, macro push-in, physics reveal, typographic close) into a 720×1280 video with background music.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a product image, brand logo, and headline, and specify the 3D product showcase format.

say_en.text: Make a 3D showcase ad from this product image, brand logo here.
say_en.note: Claude will generate four clips and compose the final video.

say_en.text: Create a 15-second 3D product showcase for this lipstick with pink background.
say_en.note: Claude will produce rotation, macro, effect, and end card as configured.
